validity.researcher_notes: Real line. The VTG list gives it as 42 km, 1400 mm, one string, in Ukraine. Two 2014 news reports from an emergency service report describe an explosion near the gas pipeline Bohorodchany-Dolyna with pressure held at 50 to 54 atmospheres and no leak. The sheet's own citations were general pages that did not name the line, but this check found line-level sources. Not a duplicate of any roster row. Caveat: no operator document or commissioning year found.
